prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished square 2D editorial story-cover illustration for a language-learning app. The attached rocket image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its refined painted gouache/printmaking aesthetic, subtle fine paper grain, strong readable realistic silhouettes, atmospheric warm cream light against deep cool blues, layered painterly shapes. Not a photograph, not 3D, not flat childish clipart. New subject: Ein Börsenmakler-Schreibtisch mit mehreren kabelgebundenen Telefonen, handschriftlichen leeren Orderzetteln und einer einzelnen Hand am Hörer, im Hintergrund die hektische Silhouette eines Verkaufsraums; Finanzverkauf und Betrug statt Luxusparty oder Schauspielerportrait. Composition: one coherent scene, the main subject clearly recognizable near the center with generous atmospheric space around it, important features away from edges. The artwork must work at small size and fit portrait and wide cards. Lower portion can be darker and calmer for an app title overlay; do not add a title or any text, labels, logos, watermark, borders, or UI. Avoid gratuitous violence or sensationalism. Make only this single cover, not a collage.
